# Quality Contract for Line Counter (Go)

Project: `peerfoil-fixture-go` · Assurance: Guided · Revision: 1 · Status: accepted

- **Author:** architect (claude-code, anthropic-claude, session null)
- **Written at:** 2026-10-21T14:22:00Z
- **Pack:** software 0.1.0
- **Architecture revision:** 1

This contract lists the evidence the project needs before work is accepted. Required
evidence blocks completion when it is missing or failed. Recommended evidence is run when
practical and its absence is recorded. Not-applicable evidence names the reason it does
not apply. A model's statement that a check passed is a claim, not evidence.

## Required evidence

| Name | Kind | Procedure |
|---|---|---|
| build | executable | `["go", "build", "./..."]` in the repository root |
| unit-tests | executable | `["go", "test", "./..."]` in the repository root |
| user-journey | human | Build the command, run it on a small text file that holds blank and indented lines, and confirm the printed count matches a hand count |
| license-check | inspection | Confirm no dependency or copied material was added; if any was, confirm its license is compatible and its notice is kept |

## Recommended evidence

| Name | Kind | Procedure |
|---|---|---|
| lint | executable | `["go", "vet", "./..."]` in the repository root |
| dependency-audit | executable | `["govulncheck", "./..."]` in the repository root; install it with `go install golang.org/x/vuln/cmd/govulncheck@latest` when missing |
| failure-handling-check | inspection | Run the command with a missing file, an unreadable file, and no argument; confirm each prints a clear error to standard error and exits with a non-zero code |
| privacy-check | inspection | Confirm the command reads only the named file, prints only counts, and logs nothing |
| accessibility-check | inspection | Read the output and errors in a terminal without color support and confirm every message carries its meaning in plain text |
| maintainability-review | inspection | Read the changed files for clear names, small functions, and godoc comments that match the behavior |
| documentation-check | inspection | Confirm the usage message matches what the command actually accepts and prints |
| release-check | inspection | On a clean checkout, run the build and test commands above and run the command once on a real file |

## Not applicable

| Name | Reason |
|---|---|
| security-scan | The project has no security scanner configured; it has no dependencies, takes one file path, stores no secrets, and makes no network calls |

## Review lenses

| Lens | Focus |
|---|---|
| correctness-reliability | Behavior matches the accepted decisions and plan; failure handling, recovery, and edge cases are covered by evidence |
| security-privacy | Input validation, command and query construction, permissions, credentials, personal data, and dependency risks |
| accessibility-ux | Keyboard use, labels, contrast, error messages, and plain-language output for user-facing surfaces |
| maintainability-docs-licensing-release | Readable code, current documentation, headers and notices, license compatibility, and packaging |

## Completion requirements

1. Every required evidence item for the phase has a current record tied to the exact revision reviewed.
2. Both phase reviewers approved, or the user accepted a recorded reduced-assurance decision.
3. The plan revision reflects every accepted change, TODO, deviation, skipped check, and deferral.
4. The first phase installs, starts, and completes one real user action.
